profileLabel.en: Adult woman (19–50 y, 60 kg reference, moderately active)
profileLabel.es: Mujer adulta (19–50 años, 60 kg de referencia, actividad moderada)

energy.source: FAO/WHO/UNU (2004). Human energy requirements. Report of a Joint FAO/WHO/UNU Expert Consultation, Rome, 17–24 October 2001. FAO Food and Nutrition Technical Report Series 1, Chapter 5, Tables 5.2 & 5.3. Calculated with Schofield BMR equation for females 30–60 y (8.126 × 60 kg + 845.6 = 1333.2 kcal/d) × PAL 1.75 (moderately active).

protein.source: WHO/FAO/UNU (2007). Protein and amino acid requirements in human nutrition. Report of a Joint WHO/FAO/UNU Expert Consultation. WHO Technical Report Series 935, Section 14, Table 46: Adult safe level of protein intake = 0.83 g/kg body weight/day (0.83 × 60 kg = 49.8 g/day).

fibre.source: WHO/FAO (2003). Diet, nutrition and the prevention of chronic diseases. Report of a Joint WHO/FAO Expert Consultation. WHO Technical Report Series 916, Section 5.1, Table 6: Population nutrient intake goal for total dietary fibre > 25 g/day.

iron.source: WHO/FAO (2004). Vitamin and mineral requirements in human nutrition (2nd ed.), Chapter 13, Table 13.2 (p. 271): Recommended Nutrient Intake (RNI) for menstruating adult females (18+ y) assuming 10% dietary iron bioavailability (representative of cereal- and legume-based diets).

calcium.source: WHO/FAO (2004). Vitamin and mineral requirements in human nutrition (2nd ed.), Chapter 4, Table 4.1 (p. 85): Recommended Nutrient Intake (RNI) for adult females (19–50 y, premenopausal) = 1000 mg/day.
